title:
Receives a JSON Object and returns a {@link UiSdlFormDataSpec}.
This transform is used to determine if the hyperparameter being edited contains
HPO Values (e.g. user can enable HPO on the hyperparameter to optimize the training process), and
if the Hyperparameter Optimization feature is enabled.

The transform accepts a JSON object with the following properties:

fieldSets {UiSdlFormFieldSet[]} - The field sets to be displayed in the form.
hyperparameter {JSON} - The hyperparameter data.
hpoFeatureEnabled {Boolean} - Feature flag for Hyperparameter Optimization.

Expected hyperparameter data:
```json
 {
   "hyperparameter": {
      // ... `currentHyperparameter` from `Reliability.ModelConfigApplicationState`
      "hpoEnabled": boolean,
   }
 }
```

If `hpoFeatureEnabled` flag is `true`, the returned {@link UiSdlFormDataSpec} contains an input element of type
{@link UiSdlSegmentedButton} with 2 buttons: `Default Single Value` and `HPO`, where the selected value is
determined by `hyperparameter.hpoEnabled`.

 ---------------------------------------------
| Default Single Value |         HPO          |
 ---------------------------------------------

When `hpoFeatureEnabled` is `false`, the returned {@link UiSdlFormDataSpec} does not contain any input elements.
name: ModelConfigEditHyperparamsFormTransform
